posts.t: Ben Kindel playing with high honor after getting hit in the skates by Sheary diving to disrupt his chance on a break-in and not going down from it.

Sabres roster housekeeping, to activate Justin Danforth and call up Conor Sheary, Tyson Kozak and Noah Östlund were placed on IR. Kozak is retroactive to last Saturday (presumably) while Östlund played on Wednesday so give him less than a week before he could come off.
Conor Sheary has been recalled from Rochester. Was debating if he’d be the guy or not but the veteran gets the nod.
The Sabres have recalled Conor Sheary and placed Noah Ostlund on injured reserve.
